explanation: It is 0 almost everywhere and fires only at D2 when the agent chose a1 but reached S2 (a rare transition) late in the episode, rising with trial number: about 5-6 around trials 92-96 and 9-10 at trials 97-99. It stays 0 at every D1 and GO step, for all common transitions, for rare a2-to-S1 transitions, and for rare a1-to-S2 transitions before about trial 90.
